# LitMeUp

> LitMeUp designs and handcrafts lighting — chandeliers, pendant lights, ceiling
> lights, wall lights and floor lamps — in Surat, Gujarat, India, and sells them
> direct to customers across India. Over 500 designs across twelve finishes,
> assembled and inspected in one workshop since 2016.

Last updated: 2026-08-19. Key facts, all published on the site:

- Shipping: free on every order, anywhere in India, no minimum order value.
- Delivery: 5–7 days from dispatch, by registered courier, tracked by email.
- Returns: 7 days from receipt; a no-questions return carries a 15% re-stocking
  fee on invoiced MRP; the fixture must be uninstalled and in original packaging.
- Damaged, defective or wrong item: report within 24 hours of delivery;
  replacement ships within 3 days of the item reaching us.
- Refunds: processed in 5–7 business days after the item arrives in good condition.
- Cancellation: not possible once confirmed, but the order can be modified within
  24 hours and before dispatch by adding items of equal or greater value.
- Warranty: 5 years against manufacturing defects.
- Payment: Mastercard, Visa, American Express, net banking, UPI and wallets.
- Materials: brass, hand-blown glass and solid steel; dimmable as standard.
- Currency: INR. Ships within India only.
- Contact: info@litmeup.in, +91 99793 40909, 69 Jalaram Industrial Estate,
  Navjivan Circle, Udhana Magdalla Road, Surat, Gujarat 395007, India.

## Where we are, and where we deliver

LitMeUp has exactly one location: the workshop in Surat, Gujarat. There are no
showrooms, dealers or stockists in any other city. Everything is sold direct and
shipped from Surat.

- [Visit the Surat workshop](https://www.litmeup.in/surat-store): 69 Jalaram Industrial Estate, Navjivan Circle, Udhana Magdalla Road, Surat, Gujarat 395007. Open Monday to Saturday, 10am to 7pm; closed Sunday.
- [Delivery to Mumbai](https://www.litmeup.in/lighting/mumbai)
- [Delivery to Delhi NCR](https://www.litmeup.in/lighting/delhi)
- [Delivery to Bangalore](https://www.litmeup.in/lighting/bangalore)
- [Delivery to Hyderabad](https://www.litmeup.in/lighting/hyderabad)
- [Delivery to Chennai](https://www.litmeup.in/lighting/chennai)
- [Delivery to Pune](https://www.litmeup.in/lighting/pune)
- [Delivery to Ahmedabad](https://www.litmeup.in/lighting/ahmedabad)
- [Delivery to Kolkata](https://www.litmeup.in/lighting/kolkata)

## Lighting guides

Sizing and light-quality guidance, each opening with a direct answer:

- [All guides](https://www.litmeup.in/guides)
- [What size chandelier do you need?](https://www.litmeup.in/guides/what-size-chandelier): room length + width in feet, read as inches of diameter; fixture height at 2.5–3 in per foot of ceiling; 7 ft floor clearance.
- [How high to hang a light over a dining table](https://www.litmeup.in/guides/how-high-to-hang-a-dining-light): 30–36 in above the tabletop; fixture width half to two-thirds of the table width.
- [How many pendants over a kitchen island?](https://www.litmeup.in/guides/how-many-pendants-over-a-kitchen-island): two up to 7 ft, three up to 10 ft; 24–30 in apart; 30–36 in above the counter.
- [How to light a living room](https://www.litmeup.in/guides/how-to-light-a-living-room): three layers (ambient, task, accent), five or more sources, 2700K throughout.
- [How to light a bedroom](https://www.litmeup.in/guides/bedroom-lighting-ideas): bedside pendants 20–26 in above the mattress, wall lights 30–36 in; 2700K or warmer.
- [Warm or cool light: which Kelvin for which room](https://www.litmeup.in/guides/warm-or-cool-light): 2700K living and bedrooms, 3000K kitchens and bathrooms, 4000K task only; CRI 90+ where colour matters.
